raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: After correctly gathering the directors’ birthdates (Eric Mendelsohn: Nov 1, 1964; Harry A. Pollard: Jan 23, 1879), the Planner reversed the comparison and concluded Judy Berlin’s director was older. They improperly compared Mendelsohn’s current age to Pollard’s age at death instead of using birth years. The correct result is that Tonight at Twelve has the older director (Pollard, born 1879).
